scope: The four Bicep workload wrappers. Shared infrastructure dependencies are listed in bootstrap-dependencies.json.
sourceVerification: Inputs and nested-module schemas were checked against the release tags below. Builds restore the corresponding versioned br/public artifacts.
resourceOwnership: AVM defines the Azure resources. The catalog wrappers supply parameters, compose the modules and return resource IDs and names.
apiInventoryScope: API versions used by the selected AVM sources. Compiled templates can include optional features that this configuration does not deploy.

notes: The Storage AVM provides the Blob diagnostics, retention and private endpoint settings used here.
Shared Key authorization is disabled. The wrapper does not expose the access-key or connection-string outputs available in the upstream module.
No pipConfiguration is supplied, so the AVM does not create a public IP.
This VM AVM has no top-level diagnosticSettings input. The example sends NIC metrics to Log Analytics and enables managed boot diagnostics; guest logs and performance collection are not configured.
The AVM publicNetworkAccess and networkAccessPolicy parameters apply to its data disks, not the VM OS disk. This example creates no data disks and does not configure OS disk export restrictions.
NODE|24-lts selects the App Service runtime channel; Azure manages its patch version.
Inbound Private Link and outbound VNet integration use separate subnets.
The privateEndpoints input creates Private Link for the managedEnvironments subresource. This is separate from the internal-load-balancer option.
The azure-monitor destination sends logs through diagnostic settings without reading workspace shared keys.
The image digest and port come from catalog/platform.json and are set at compile time.
External app ingress allows clients outside the environment to connect through its private endpoint. Public network access remains disabled.

previewApis.reason: The selected AVM diagnostic-setting implementations use this preview API. It is included in the demo's documented preview dependencies.

vmImage.verification: This version was found in swedencentral through the Microsoft.Compute image-version API (2024-03-01). The check read metadata; it did not deploy a VM.
vmImage.compatibilityVerification: Image metadata reports x64, Generation 2, Trusted Launch and accelerated networking support, with a 30 GiB Linux OS disk.

validation.compiledInterfaceChecks: All four templates and parameter examples match implementation-contract.json. Checks cover region and size choices, disabled AVM telemetry and resource creation through AVM.
validation.compiledApiInventoryNotes: The inventory includes nested templates and inactive optional AVM features. No additional preview APIs were found. CI rebuilds the templates for each change.
